name: Nana and Jedi's kitchen (Enfield), evaluation room 3
setting: Cosy, warm and a little old-fashioned: a grandmother's kitchen in a semi-detached house in Enfield, north London, on a long golden summer evening, empty of people.
palette: the walls are warm cream above soft sage-green tongue-and-groove panelling; the panelling's top edge is at a grown-up's waist height, 36% of the way up the back wall from the floor; the floor is terracotta tiles; dark wood, brass and china
box: a shallow box in one-point perspective: a wide back wall running the full width, narrow side walls, a thin strip of ceiling, a low floor band
light: the only daylight comes from the window over the counter and the open back door, low golden evening sun

k1.name: the counter wall (north)
k1.light: golden evening light comes through the window above the counter and lies across the counter top and the tiles in front of it; the open back door is to the right, out of view, adding a warm glow from the right

objects.label: wooden counter with kettle and teapot
objects.text: a long wooden counter with cupboard doors beneath, and on it a cream enamel kettle and a brown teapot with a knitted cosy
objects.size: the counter top at a grown-up's waist, level with the top of the panelling

objects.label: window over the counter
objects.text: a window with a white frame above the counter, showing a green garden hedge and a strip of evening sky
objects.size: its sill a hand's width above the counter

objects.label: cream cooker
objects.text: a cream cooker with four rings and an oven door, standing against the wall
objects.size: the same height as the counter

k2.name: the dresser wall (east), to the right of the counter wall
k2.light: the window is to the left of this wall and the open back door to the right, so the wall is evenly lit with warm light from both sides and faint shadows straight behind each object

objects.label: tall pine dresser with a red tin on top
objects.text: a tall pine dresser, plates standing on its upper shelves, and on its very top shelf one round red biscuit tin with nothing written on it
objects.size: reaching almost to the ceiling strip

objects.label: kitchen table and two chairs
objects.text: a small square kitchen table with a checked cloth and two wooden chairs, nothing on the table
objects.size: the table top at a grown-up's waist

objects.label: lighthouse calendar
objects.text: a calendar on the wall with a picture of a lighthouse above and a plain empty grid below, with no numbers or words

k3.name: the back-door wall (south), opposite the counter wall
k3.light: golden evening light pours through the open back door in the middle of this wall and lies in a long bright patch on the tiles; the rest of the wall is warm and soft

objects.label: pair of wellington boots
objects.text: a pair of green wellington boots standing on the tiles

objects.label: open back door to the garden
objects.text: a dark wooden back door standing wide open, and through it a glimpse of a sunny garden: a lawn, a flower bed, a wooden fence
objects.size: the door reaches almost to the ceiling strip

objects.label: coat on a hook
objects.text: a single brass hook on the wall with a navy jacket hanging from it
objects.size: the hook at a grown-up's eye height

k4.name: the fridge wall (west), to the left of the counter wall
k4.light: the window is to the right of this wall, so warm light comes from the right and shadows lean left

objects.label: cream fridge
objects.text: a cream fridge with a rounded top and nothing on its door
objects.size: a little taller than a grown-up

objects.label: larder cupboard, closed
objects.text: a tall painted larder cupboard, its door closed, with a small brass knob
objects.size: reaching almost to the ceiling strip

objects.label: broom
objects.text: a wooden broom leaning against the wall
objects.size: as tall as a grown-up's shoulder
